## Background 

We ran 3 AlphaFold2 Predictions,


- HIV-PR_monomer
_ HIV-PR_dimer
- My find-a-gene protein sequence


Here we analyze the resulting models and make some diagnostic plots that inform on model reliability 


## HIV-PR Monomer

Reading Monomer File

```{r}
list.files(path="HIV_monomer_94b5b_1",
           full.names = FALSE,
           pattern= ".pdb")
```

```{r}
pdb_files <- list.files(path = "HIV_monomer_94b5b_1",
                        full.names = TRUE,
                        pattern = ".pdb")
```


### Aligning PDB File

```{r}
library(bio3d)

pdb<- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit=TRUE, exefile="msa")
pdb
             
```


### RMSD

Calculate the RMSD of all models to each other (i.e. pairwise RMSD)

```{r}
rd <- rmsd(pdb, fit = TRUE)
range(rd)
```

### RMSD Heatmap

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd) <- paste0("m", 1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m", 1:5)

pheatmap(rd)
```

### pLDDT 

```{r}
 plotb3(pdb$b[1,], typ= "l", lwd=2)
points(pdb$b[2,], typ="l",col="red")
points(pdb$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdb$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdb$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")

```


### PAE score plots

```{r}

library(jsonlite)


pae_files_monomer <- list.files(
  path="HIV_monomer_94b5b_1",
  pattern=".*model.*\\.json",
  full.names=TRUE
)

pae_files_monomer
```

```{r}
pae1_monomer <- read_json(
  pae_files_monomer[1],
  simplifyVector=TRUE
)

pae5_monomer <- read_json(
  pae_files_monomer[5],
  simplifyVector=TRUE
)
```


```{r}
attributes(pae1_monomer)

head(pae1_monomer$plddt)

pae1_monomer$max_pae
pae5_monomer$max_pae

```


```{r}
plot.dmat(pae1_monomer$pae,
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col="black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
```


```{r}
plot.dmat(pae5_monomer$pae,
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col="black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
```


### RMSF

Calculate RMSF - how far apart each amino acid is from across all 5 AlphaFold models


```{r}

rf <- rmsf(pdb$xyz)

plotb3(rf, sse=pdb)
abline(v=100, col="gray", ylab="RMSF")

```

### Residue conservation from alignment file

```{r}
aln_file <- list.files(path= "HIV_monomer_94b5b_1",
                       pattern= ".a3m$",
                       full.names = TRUE)

aln <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper= TRUE)
```

### Calculating Residue Conservation

```{r}
sim <- conserv(aln)
```

Plot this conservation result.

```{r}
m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])

plotb3(sim[1:99], sse=trim.pdb(m1.pdb, chain="A"),
       ylab="Conservation Score")
```



### Consensus Sequence

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.9)
con$seq
```

### Map Conservation Scores onto the PDB Structure

```{r}
m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])

sim_fixed <- sim[aln$ali[1,] != "-"]

occ <- vec2resno(sim_fixed, m1.pdb$atom$resno)

write.pdb(m1.pdb, o=occ, file="m1_conserv.pdb")
```




### AF scores pLDDT Scores

The pLDDT scores are stored in the pdb models in "B-factors" col and in a seprate JSON format file in the results directory. We can use either:
```{r}
m1.pdb$atom$b
```







## HIV-PR Dimer

Reading Dimer File

```{r}
list.files(path="HIV_Dimer_23119_0",
           full.names = TRUE,
           pattern= ".pdb")
```

```{r}
dimer_files <- list.files(path = "HIV_Dimer_23119_0",
                        full.names = TRUE,
                        pattern = ".pdb")
```


### Aligning PDB File

```{r}
pdb_dimer <- pdbaln(dimer_files, fit=TRUE, exefile="msa")
pdb_dimer

```

### RMSD

```{r}

rd_dimer <- rmsd(pdb_dimer, fit = TRUE)
range(rd_dimer)
```

### Heatmap


```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd_dimer) <- paste0("m", 1:5)
rownames(rd_dimer) <- paste0("m", 1:5)

pheatmap(rd_dimer)
```

### pLDDT 

```{r}
plotb3(pdb_dimer$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2)
points(pdb_dimer$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdb_dimer$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdb_dimer$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdb_dimer$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")
```


### PAE score plots

```{r}
library(jsonlite)

pae_files <- list.files(path="HIV_Dimer_23119_0",
                        pattern=".*model.*\\.json",
                        full.names=TRUE)

pae_files
```


```{r}
pae1 <- read_json(pae_files[1], simplifyVector=TRUE)
pae5 <- read_json(pae_files[5], simplifyVector=TRUE)
```


```{r}
attributes(pae1)

pae1$max_pae
pae5$max_pae
```



```{r}
plot.dmat(pae1$pae,
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col="black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
```


```{r}
plot.dmat(pae5$pae,
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col="black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
```


### RMSF


```{r}
rf_dimer <- rmsf(pdb_dimer$xyz)

plotb3(rf_dimer, ylab="RMSF")
abline(v=100, col="gray")
```




### Residue conservation from alignment file

```{r}
aln_file_dimer <- list.files(path= "HIV_Dimer_23119_0",
                       pattern= ".a3m$",
                       full.names = TRUE)

aln_dimer <- read.fasta(aln_file_dimer[1], to.upper= TRUE)
```


### Calculating Residue Conservation

```{r}
sim_dimer <- conserv(aln_dimer)
```

Plot this conservation result.

```{r}
m1_dimer.pdb <- read.pdb(dimer_files[1])

plotb3(sim_dimer[1:99], sse=trim.pdb(m1_dimer.pdb, chain="A"),
       ylab="Conservation Score")
```

### Consensus Sequence

```{r}
con_dimer <- consensus(aln_dimer, cutoff = 0.9)
con_dimer$seq
```

### Map Conservation Scores onto the PDB Structure


```{r}
m1_dimer.pdb <- read.pdb(dimer_files[1])

sim_fixed_dimer <- sim_dimer[aln_dimer$ali[1,] != "-"]

occ_dimer <- vec2resno(rep(sim_fixed_dimer, 2),
                       m1_dimer.pdb$atom$resno)

write.pdb(m1_dimer.pdb, o=occ_dimer,
          file="m1_dimer_conserv.pdb")
```


### AF scores pLDDT Scores

The pLDDT scores are stored in the pdb models in "B-factors" col and in a seprate JSON format file in the reults dierctory. We can use either:

```{r}
m1_dimer.pdb$atom$b
```
